name: Flamingo Split-Face Atelier Illusion
image_purpose: editorial fashion and surreal prop-integration concept

prompt.project_info: Create a tactile surreal portrait in a dim taxidermy-inspired atelier using a safe sculptural flamingo prop for a split-face visual illusion.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional androgynous fashion model with pale natural complexion, short hair, intense visible eye, and structured pearl-white satin blazer with secure coverage; they hold a large lightweight flamingo sculpture vertically beside the face, aligned visually with the jaw without covering the airway or touching the eye.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 eye-level portrait photographed through out-of-focus antique glass jars and wireframes, centered subject with layered foreground occlusion, deep atelier shadows and negative space.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Moody cinematic chiaroscuro, cool blue rim light on satin and flamingo curve, tactile analog atmosphere, safe prop handling.
prompt.technical_specs: Hasselblad H6D-100c, 210mm telephoto at f/3.2, compressed space, Cinestill 800T simulation, visible grain, detailed feathers, porcelain, fabric, and skin pores.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic surreal editorial portrait of a clearly adult fictional androgynous model in a pearl-white satin blazer, holding a lightweight painted porcelain-and-feather flamingo sculpture beside the face to create a split-face illusion, prop safely away from eye and airway, dim atelier with glass jars and wireframes in soft foreground blur, intense visible eye, cool blue rim light, deep chiaroscuro, Hasselblad H6D-100c 210mm f/3.2, Cinestill 800T grain, 9:16, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, dangerous prop contact, obstruction of airway, eye injury, gore, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, live-animal harm, CGI, plastic skin, watermark, logo, text

assets.name: flamingo atelier illusion reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the flamingo split-face alignment, white blazer, dark atelier, foreground glass, blue rim light, and analog grain; keep the adult fictional identity, prop construction, and atelier details replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the surreal illusion and occluded framing, but use a lightweight safe sculpture rather than a live animal or hazardous contact. Keep identity and environment replaceable.

policy_review.changes: Removed voyeuristic framing and live-animal implication; clarified a fictional adult subject and safe lightweight prop held away from the eye and airway.
policy_review.notes: Surreal prop use is non-graphic and nonsexual.
